TECHNICAL
WHAT: Claude Code hook response format — returning {} means 'no opinion' and Claude Code still prompts the user. Must return explicit allow to actually suppress the prompt.
WHERE: src/app/api/hooks/pre-tool-use/route.ts
HOW: Safe commands must return:
```typescript
return NextResponse.json({
  hookSpecificOutput: {
    hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
    permissionDecision: 'allow',
    permissionDecisionReason: 'Auto-approved by Pixel Office',
  },
});
```
Risky commands with no browser connected still return {} (fallthrough to terminal).
Risky commands with browser connected block and send to approval queue.
WHY: Claude Code treats {} as hook abstaining — its own permission system then runs and prompts the user.
GOTCHA: This was the #1 user complaint. The fix was a 5-line change but the symptom (user sees prompts for safe commands) was obvious and frustrating.
